notes.title: ONLY 1 DAY LEFT! GAME RELEASE SCHEDULE 🌍
notes.notes:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/27b9ad62543f47336978072a56216116ce618121.png

You won't be able to hide from this release! FEMBOY FUTA HOUSE is coming out tomorrow, and we'll finally have a chance to share the results of our work with you! ❤️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602290/FEMBOY_FUTA_HOUSE
We know that you, our beloved players, have been waiting for this for a long time. Many of you are from different corners of the world, so we have prepared a release map in different time zones for countries and regions. Explore it carefully and set your alarm clocks so you can be the first to break into dorm life and enjoy all the delights of the school of magic 🔥

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/5197b693658bc04556ea57ce33527fda997c793d.png

⏰ When is the release time?

Each region has its own launch time, and we don't want you to guess and figure it out yourself. That's why we've put everything together in a handy image — just find your region and remember the time!

🔹 September 12
9 AM - Los Angeles

10 AM - Mexico 

11 AM - Houston

12 PM - New York

1 PM - San Paulo

3 PM - London

6 PM - Varsovia and Cape Town

7 PM - Moscow

8 PM - Dubai

9 PM - Almaty

11 PM - Bangkok and Krasnoyarsk

🔹 September 13

1 AM - Seoul and Tokyo

2 AM  - Vladivostok

3 AM -  Hong Kong and Sydney

10 AM -  Anchorage

💖 Thank you for being with us all this time, for your support, reviews, and help in making the game better. Tomorrow we will finally meet you at FEMBOY FUTA HOUSE — and we promise this adventure will be unforgettable.

In the meantime, get ready, add the game to your wishlists, and charge your magic wands, because tomorrow it all begins for real!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602290/FEMBOY_FUTA_HOUSE/

notes.title: Pre-release devlog! 👑
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/f6c18f78f502d962ffe904ed96c100057040a3c2.png"]
👑 Princes, we’ve been silent for a while... because the kingdom has been bustling with work!
Over the past three months, Becoming a King has grown and matured: new walls have risen, battlefields have been prepared, weapons polished, and the prince’s throne is nearly ready…

We've been working so hard to welcome our heir that we sometimes forget to report back to our noble monarchs!

In this devlog, we’ll tell you everything that has happened since the last update — and what awaits you very, very soon.

Be sure to read all the way to the end - something exciting awaits you there… 👀


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/24becd320aefdc5b92540e716d5357780dfe3590.jpg"]
📖 The story grows deeper, with more scenes and sharper turns!
Every prince will now have the chance to learn much more about the kingdom and the lady of his heart. Moreover, the story of the prince itself will grow progressively! You will uncover the truth of your parent’s death soon enough…

Story expanded to 25+ weeks 

Fully reworked dialogue journal interface

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/4683b1ba4421dbf4c6d3d4314e1750df24a67e75.jpg"]
🛍️ New locations and activities for our noble monarchs!
To keep your reign exciting, we’ve opened the gates to new places and invented new activities. A full-fledged combat system is now live, the city now features real shops, courtrooms, an arena…

You won’t get bored once you step outside the castle walls!

🔔 City improvements:
Shops now available at the town square and brothel

New levels added for Patrol, Court, and Performance activities

New backgrounds: forest, theater, court, shops

Interface improvements across several screens and systems

Unique music tracks for meta-activities (Hunt, Court, Performance)

Updated music for main locations


🗡️ Story battles:
Fight with the assassin (main story)

Fight with the bouncers (part of one girl's storyline)


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/22c42b73be021794ea37a370d5b911cad108eaa9.jpg"]
❤️‍🔥 You may have noticed... Becoming a King has pushed some boundaries.
As of this month, the game is officially 18+ only! All intimate scenes will now be included in the main game! No more extra downloads or patches needed to truly get to know your future queen…

But worry not, dear romantics! We're also continuing work on 16+ dating content — and we promise, no lady will deny a proper prince a lovely date.

New H-scenes have been added for several girls…  

…but we won’t spoil the surprise just yet 🤭

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/5056ca637f047ee7acd700c925b69e0d8426f596.jpg"]

🛠️ And beyond all that, your rule just got even more comfortable!

We’ve added a series of quality-of-life improvements to enhance your experience:

Week counter added

 Notifications for stat, relationship, and gold changes 

 Save system reworked: auto-save now triggers at the start of each week
[hr][/hr]
💬 We know you've waited patiently — and we thank you for it. With each new build, we draw closer to the biggest moment yet:


Full release of Becoming a King, coming in late August!


Thank you for staying with us, supporting us, sharing feedback, and helping to shape this kingdom. We’ll see you very soon, heirs to the throne!

With love,
Your Becoming a King team 💕



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/5412716d13c4d4b6f7cd68c1d434095354bb3500.png"]
